main.job: potential complement: can't manage to / it won't be possible to (吃不了, 去不了, 忘不了)
main.why: Everyday speech uses V不了 far more than 不能 for 'can't'; learners who miss it misread refusals and plans.
Constant in complaints and surprise; word order trips English speakers.

main.job: since (given that) X, then Y — reasoning from an accepted fact
main.why: Standard way to push a decision in conversation; easily confused with 因为.

main.job: no wonder (the reason just became clear)
anyway / whatever happens, the outcome is the same
main.why: Very frequent spoken discourse marker, with an attitude English 'anyway' lacks.

main.job: on earth / exactly (pressing for an answer in a question)
main.why: Frequent in real questions and arguments; tone matters.
Key softener for disagreeing in discussion at B2.

main.job: can't bear to give up, leave or spend on something
main.why: Emotionally loaded everyday verb with no single English equivalent.

main.job: only after a lot of effort (finally managed)
main.why: Frequent in stories; the 不 looks like negation but isn't.

spares.job: I'm afraid (that) / probably — softening bad news
spares.why: Polite hedge used at work and with strangers.

spares.job: after all (reminding of a fact that explains things)
spares.why: Common in explaining and defending positions.

spares.job: seems / when you try it (看起来, 听起来, 用起来)

spares.why: Standard way to explain obligations you don't like.

jobs_covered.identity/existence/location (是, 有, 在): assumed known below B2 (A1 core, not re-taught at B2 per R-SEL-06)
jobs_covered.negation: 不/没 assumed known; 不了 adds 'can't manage', 不见得 adds hedged negation
jobs_covered.questions: 吗/A-not-A assumed known; 到底 adds pressing questions

shape.notes: B2 bare glossary: per R-SEL-06 the A1 building blocks are assumed and the slots go to constructions and discourse glue that still block fluent understanding. No closed set is started (connector pairs are open classes). Slots: 3 construction, 3 glue, 2 verb_adj, 2 phrase, 0 nouns.
